# Classifyre

> Open-source data governance you run yourself. Classifyre finds personal data and secrets across 40+ systems, masks them automatically inside the query, and lets people query everything with SQL, Excel and Power BI. Every read is logged. Apache-2.0, self-hosted, made in Austria.

Classifyre is one product with every feature open source, including SSO, roles, tenants, masking and the SQL gateway. Enterprise is services: a fixed-price pilot, implementation, an SLA subscription and tailoring.

## What it does

- Finds personal data (41 entity types, including Austrian, German and Swiss identifiers) and secrets (27 patterns) in databases, lakehouses, object storage, wikis, tickets, mail and Git; custom detectors by regex, model or prompt.
- Masks classified columns by default: redacted (****), last four (••••1234), hashed (joins and counts still work; pseudonymisation, not anonymisation), empty, or hidden. Masks apply inside the query, so WHERE, JOIN and GROUP BY cannot see past them.
- Grants Data reader or Data reader, unmasked to groups per workspace, source or table, with end dates; row filters per group; access requests decided by owners and stewards.
- Serves the tables to the SQL page, exports (Excel, CSV, Parquet), a PostgreSQL-protocol endpoint for Power BI, Excel, Tableau and DBeaver, and AI agents over MCP, all through the same masks.
- Records every read per table and person, with the channel used.
- Runs as one Docker image or a Helm chart on Kubernetes; OpenShift with Enterprise support. Runs offline.
